task: get me a svg of a pelican riding a bycicle

args.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#e8f4f8"/>
  
  <!-- Ground -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="260" rx="180" ry="20" fill="#8b7355"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Frame -->
  <path d="M 140 240 L 200 180 L 260 240" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="200" cy="180" r="5" fill="#333"/>
  
  <!-- Front Wheel -->
  <circle cx="140" cy="240" r="35" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3" fill="#e8f4f8"/>
  <circle cx="140" cy="240" r="30" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="240" x2="140" y2="205" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="240" x2="175" y2="225" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="140" y1="240" x2="105" y2="225" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Rear Wheel -->
  <circle cx="260" cy="240" r="35" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3" fill="#e8f4f8"/>
  <circle cx="260" cy="240" r="30" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="240" x2="260" y2="205" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="240" x2="295" y2="225" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="260" y1="240" x2="225" y2="225" stroke="#ccc" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Seat -->
  <ellipse cx="230" cy="175" rx="15" ry="8" fill="#666"/>
  
  <!-- Bicycle Handlebars -->
  <path d="M 140 180 L 120 160 L 100 170" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Body -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="150" rx="45" ry="35" fill="#ffcc99"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Head -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="110" r="28" fill="#ffcc99"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Beak (large pouch) -->
  <path d="M 200 110 Q 260 140 250 180 L 230 170 Q 200 150 190 120 Z" fill="#ff9966"/>
  <path d="M 200 110 Q 260 140 250 180 L 230 170 Q 200 150 190 120 Z" fill="#ffcc99" stroke="#e68a4d" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Eye -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="105" r="3" fill="#333"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Wing -->
  <path d="M 165 145 Q 180 170 195 155" stroke="#ffcc99" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Pelican Tail -->
  <path d="M 160 145 L 150 170 L 170 160" fill="#ffcc99"/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <path d="M 185 155 L 175 200" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 215 155 L 225 200" stroke="#8b4513" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx="175" cy="200" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#8b4513"/>
  <ellipse cx="225" cy="200" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#8b4513"/>
  
  <!-- Helmet -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="95" r="18" fill="#ff6600"/>
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="95" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#ff6600" stroke="#cc3300" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Helmet Detail -->
  <path d="M 185 95 L 215 95 M 200 81 L 200 109" stroke="#cc3300" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>

args.message: Created an SVG file (pelican_bicycle.svg) showing a pelican riding a bicycle. The pelican has its characteristic large beak pouch, is wearing a helmet, and the bicycle includes wheels, frame, handlebars, and seat.
